title: Ambiguity
summary: AMBIGU'ITY, noun [Latin ambiguitas, from ambigo.] Doubtfulness or uncertainty of signification, from a word's being susceptible of different meanings; double meaning. Words should be used which admit

inlines.v: AMBIGU'ITY, noun [Latin ambiguitas, from ambigo.] Doubtfulness or uncertainty of signification, from a word's being susceptible of different meanings; double meaning. Words should be used which admit of no ambiguity
